# Environmental Data Analysis: Homework 1

---

## Exercise 1 — Statistical Populations

**a. Bark beetle & woodpecker fecundity (Greater Yellowstone)**
- **Population:** All three-toed woodpecker breeding females in the Greater Yellowstone ecosystem during a bark beetle outbreak
- **Sampling unit:** Individual breeding female woodpecker (paired with a local bark beetle abundance measure at her territory)

**b. Green building design & awareness (Massachusetts)**
- **Population:** All first-time home builders in Massachusetts
- **Sampling unit:** Individual first-time home builder

**c. Soil pH heterogeneity (Mount Toby State Forest)**
- **Population:** All possible soil sampling locations within Mount Toby State Forest
- **Sampling unit:** A soil sample at a defined location (e.g., a point on a grid or transect)

**d. Tree infestation by Asian Longhorn Beetle (Worcester, MA)**
- **Population:** All trees in the city of Worcester, MA
- **Sampling unit:** Individual tree

**e. Watershed imperviousness & base flow (southern New England)**
- **Population:** All 3rd-order streams in southern New England
- **Sampling unit:** Individual 3rd-order stream watershed

---

## Exercise 2 — Data Types & Structure

**a. Wind direction on Mount Greylock**

| Attribute | Answer |
|---|---|
| Data type | Circular |
| Dependent variable | Wind direction |
| Independent variable | None (single-variable test of randomness) |
| Sampling unit | One hourly wind direction measurement |
| Statistical population | All possible hourly wind directions at that station |
| Sample size | n = 1,000 |

**b. Soil pH variability (Mount Toby)**

| Attribute | Answer |
|---|---|
| Data type | Continuous (with spatial/time-series structure along transect) |
| Dependent variable | Soil pH |
| Independent variable | Distance along transect (spatial position) |
| Sampling unit | 1 m soil sample point |
| Statistical population | All possible 1 m points along the transect across the forest |
| Sample size | n = 1,000 (1 km ÷ 1 m intervals) |

**c. Green building choice & awareness (Pioneer Valley)**

| Attribute | Answer |
|---|---|
| Data type | Dependent = Binary (yes/no); Independent = Continuous/ordinal index |
| Dependent variable | Use of green building practices (yes/no) |
| Independent variable | Green building awareness index |
| Sampling unit | Individual new home builder |
| Statistical population | All new home builders in Massachusetts |
| Sample size | n = 100 |
